name: Bacares (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bacares (a tower on yellow, a cross of Santiago and a tree).
history: Bacares was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía on 4 July 2000 to adopt its symbols but did not do so until January 2007; the flag is described as red, 150 by 100 centimetres, with the municipal heraldic arms at its centre.

features.role: Bacares arms — tower, cross of Santiago and tree
